answer: Cloned keys break when one optical lane across water cannot be leased twice. Lock 58 units, draw rock R=H(pubkey||cove||tide) mod the island chart, and at minute (hash mod 29)+5 tilt a 9 cm hand mirror to azimuth (hash mod 180) so the first glint at the grove photodiode 1.4 km inland lands in that hash's 22 ms bin. Two reef peers replay the photodiode tape and void any rock already on a live tide or mid-glint refund. An azimuth miss over 1.2 deg, an off-bin glint, or a reused cove-id burns 15 units and grounds the key 9 epochs; a cloned light curve or second fault empties the stake 16 epochs.
